projectContext.description: voiceover-matcher-subtitle: AI-powered pipeline for matching voiceover to stock footage

userStories.title: Generate sprint stories for otio focus area
acceptanceCriteria: Read scripts/ralph/config/ralph-config.json to understand the 'otio' focus area
Read scripts/ralph/session/prompt.md for project context and architecture notes
Read scripts/ralph/state/queue.json for interview details (story outline, architecture decisions, key files)
Read CLAUDE.md for project conventions and known issues
Analyze the codebase to find 8-12 specific improvements for 'otio'
Add stories US-56-002 through US-56-012 to scripts/ralph/state/prd.json (MUST use sprint-prefixed IDs)
Each story MUST have 4-6 testable acceptance criteria
Each story MUST have a 'notes' field with: (1) tier classification, (2) exact source file paths, (3) line number ranges if removing/moving code
IMPORTANT: All generated stories MUST have passes set to false - do NOT run tests or evaluate whether they already pass

Mark this story (US-56-001) as passes: true when done
userStories.notes: Seed story completed. Analyzed src/otio/ (9 modules: timeline.py, tracks.py, entities.py, export.py, xml_export.py, reporting.py, utils.py, types.py, __init__.py) and tests/ (15 test files). Found: 3x duplicated _has_problematic_path, 2x duplicated _is_audio_only, hardcoded 01:00:00:00 in xml_export not using config, duplicated frames_to_tc, limited EDL colors, no NTSC detection, logging-only clip warnings, no audio validation, no segment map versioning, V9/V10 always show gaps in stats.

userStories.title: Deduplicate _has_problematic_path and _is_audio_only across otio modules
acceptanceCriteria: _has_problematic_path is defined ONLY in src/otio/utils.py and imported by timeline.py, tracks.py, and entities.py
_is_audio_only is defined ONLY in src/otio/utils.py (or timeline.py) and imported by tracks.py — no duplicate definitions remain
AUDIO_ONLY_EXTS constant is defined once and shared across all modules that need it
All existing tests in tests/test_otio_*.py continue to pass after the refactor
Add test in tests/test_otio_utils.py verifying _has_problematic_path handles unicode, replacement chars, and ASCII-only paths
userStories.notes: Completed. Moved _has_problematic_path, _is_audio_only, AUDIO_ONLY_EXTS, NON_MEDIA_EXTS to src/otio/utils.py. Updated imports in timeline.py, tracks.py, entities.py to use shared definitions. Removed 3 duplicate _has_problematic_path definitions and 2 duplicate _is_audio_only definitions. Added 17 new tests (TestHasProblematicPath, TestIsAudioOnly, TestSharedConstants) in test_otio_utils.py covering unicode, replacement chars, CJK, emoji, ASCII paths, and audio extension detection. All 172 core otio tests pass (2 pre-existing failures unrelated to this change).

userStories.title: Extract shared frames_to_tc into otio utils and eliminate duplication
acceptanceCriteria: A single frames_to_tc(frames, frame_rate, start_frame_offset, separator) function exists in src/otio/utils.py
src/otio/export.py:337-350 uses the shared function instead of defining its own
src/otio/reporting.py:187-199 uses the shared function instead of defining its own
Timecode parsing logic (tc_parts splitting at export.py:330-335 and reporting.py:180-185) is extracted into a parse_timecode_to_frames() utility
Add tests verifying frames_to_tc for edge cases: 0 frames, frame_rate=29.97 rounded, drop-frame separator
userStories.notes: Tier: refactor (low risk). Source files: src/otio/export.py:330-350 (timecode parsing + frames_to_tc), src/otio/reporting.py:180-199 (timecode parsing + frames_to_tc), src/otio/utils.py (destination). Both functions are nearly identical — extract to utils.py, add drop_frame separator support. The parse_timecode_to_frames helper should handle both ':' and ';' separators.

userStories.title: Use configurable timeline_start_tc in XML export instead of hardcoded 01:00:00:00
acceptanceCriteria: generate_davinci_media_xml() accepts timeline_start_tc parameter and uses it in the 3 hardcoded locations
generate_davinci_sequence_xml() accepts timeline_start_tc parameter and uses it in the 3 hardcoded locations
The <string> element at xml_export.py:361 uses the parameter instead of literal '01:00:00:00'
The <frame> calculation at xml_export.py:362 uses parsed timecode instead of fps_int*3600
Add test verifying XML output with non-default timecode (e.g., '00:00:00:00') contains correct <string> and <frame> values
userStories.notes: Tier: bug fix (medium risk). Source files: src/otio/xml_export.py:361-362 (media XML timecode), src/otio/xml_export.py:700-701 (media XML helper sequence), src/otio/xml_export.py:775-776 (sequence XML timecode). All three locations hardcode '01:00:00:00' and fps_int*3600. The config already has OutputConfig.timeline_start_tc='01:00:00:00' (src/config/sections/output.py:67) and types.py:38 has DEFAULT_TIMELINE_START. Use parse_timecode_to_frames from US-56-003 to calculate the frame offset.

userStories.title: Add NTSC flag detection for drop-frame timecodes in XML export
acceptanceCriteria: _validate_frame_rate returns a tuple (timebase_int, is_ntsc) instead of just int, or a separate _is_ntsc_rate function exists
XML <ntsc> elements use 'TRUE' for 29.97 and 59.94 fps timebases instead of always 'FALSE'
EDL FCM line uses 'DROP FRAME' when frame rate is 29.97 or 59.94 and drop_frame=True
Add test verifying XML output with 29.97fps has <ntsc>TRUE</ntsc> and 30fps has <ntsc>FALSE</ntsc>
Add test verifying _validate_frame_rate correctly identifies NTSC rates (23.976, 29.97, 59.94)
userStories.notes: Tier: enhancement (medium risk). Source files: src/otio/xml_export.py:29-54 (_validate_frame_rate), src/otio/xml_export.py:354,358,692,698,770,779 (all <ntsc>FALSE</ntsc> elements). NTSC rates are 23.976, 29.97, 59.94 — these should set ntsc=TRUE in the XML. The current code always writes FALSE which may cause import issues in DaVinci when project is set to NTSC. STANDARD_NLE_RATES at xml_export.py:26 already lists them.

userStories.title: Add pre-flight media validation before timeline assembly
acceptanceCriteria: A validate_media_paths(matches, downloaded_segments) function exists that runs BEFORE create_timeline()
It reports missing files, audio-only files, problematic paths, and non-media files in a summary dict
The summary includes counts by category and lists affected segment indices
create_timeline() calls validate_media_paths() at the top and logs a summary before proceeding
Add test with mock match results containing mixed valid/invalid paths, verify summary accuracy
userStories.notes: Tier: enhancement (medium risk). Source files: src/otio/timeline.py:44-134 (individual validation functions _is_audio_only, _is_non_media, _has_problematic_path, _is_missing_file called per-clip at lines 830-832, 931, 1029, 1139). Currently each clip is validated inline during track building — failures create gaps mid-timeline with no upfront summary. The pre-flight scan should use the same validation functions but collect all issues first, then log a table: 'Media Validation: 95 valid, 3 audio-only (S012,S045,S099), 1 missing (S023)'.

userStories.title: Add proactive clip budget tracking with auto-lite mode
acceptanceCriteria: A ClipBudgetTracker class exists that estimates total clips before timeline assembly based on match count and enabled tracks
When estimated clips exceed CLIP_COUNT_WARNING_THRESHOLD (2500), it logs a recommendation to disable V4-V8 tracks
When estimated clips exceed CLIP_COUNT_ERROR_THRESHOLD (3000), it auto-disables strategy tracks (V7-V8) and logs the action
The tracker integrates into create_timeline() before track building begins
Add test simulating 400 segments with all tracks enabled, verify auto-disable triggers at threshold
userStories.notes: Tier: enhancement (medium risk). Source files: src/otio/timeline.py:36-37 (thresholds), src/otio/timeline.py:163-188 (_log_clip_count_warnings — currently post-hoc logging only), src/otio/timeline.py:410-424 (track count determination). Formula: clips = segments * (1 + num_alternatives + num_secondary + len(strategy_tracks) + entity_tracks). For 100 segments with all 10 tracks: ~1000 clips. For 400 segments: ~4000 clips (over limit). The auto-lite should modify the config values (num_alternatives, include_strategy_tracks) before track building.

userStories.title: Add voiceover audio duration validation against SRT timeline
acceptanceCriteria: When actual_vo_duration is detected, compare it against the last segment's end time (scaled by time_scale_factor)
Log a warning if actual audio is shorter than timeline end (content will be cut off)
Log info if trailing silence exceeds 30 seconds (potential alignment issue)
The validation runs at timeline.py after actual_vo_duration is determined (around line 512-524)
Add test with actual_vo_duration=100s but last_srt_end=120s, verify warning is logged
userStories.notes: Tier: enhancement (low risk). Source files: src/otio/timeline.py:512-524 (actual_vo_duration detection via ffprobe), src/otio/timeline.py:543-557 (time_scale_factor calculation). The time_scale_factor auto-calculation at line 548 already compares actual vs SRT durations, but doesn't warn when actual < scaled SRT end. Add validation after line 560: if actual_vo_duration < last_srt_end * time_scale_factor, warn about cutoff. If actual_vo_duration > last_srt_end * time_scale_factor + 30, warn about excessive trailing silence.

userStories.title: Enhance _find_audio_for_voiceover with size-based selection and validation
acceptanceCriteria: _find_audio_for_voiceover returns the largest audio file when multiple candidates exist in the same directory
The function logs which file was selected and its size when multiple candidates are found
If only one candidate exists, it is returned without size comparison (current behavior preserved)
Add test with 3 mock audio files of different sizes in a temp directory, verify largest is selected
Add test with single audio file, verify current first-match behavior is preserved
userStories.notes: Tier: enhancement (low risk). Source files: src/otio/timeline.py:56-85 (_find_audio_for_voiceover). Current behavior returns first match from extension loop (line 73-76), then first match from pattern loop (line 79-83). When a directory has voiceover.mp3 (300MB main audio) and audio.mp3 (10MB click track), the pattern order determines which is returned, not file size. Change: collect all candidates, sort by size descending, return largest. Log: 'Found 3 audio candidates, selected voiceover.mp3 (312MB)'.

userStories.title: Fix V9/V10 track coverage stats to reflect actual entity clip data
acceptanceCriteria: _calculate_track_coverage accepts optional entity_images and entity_videos parameters
When entity data is provided, V9/V10 stats reflect actual clip counts instead of always showing gaps
When entity data is not provided, V9/V10 stats show 'N/A' or are omitted instead of misleading 100% gap
Add test with mock entity_images dict containing 5 entities, verify V9 clip_count > 0
Add test without entity data, verify V9/V10 coverage is reported as unavailable
userStories.notes: Tier: bug fix (low risk). Source files: src/otio/reporting.py:136-141 (V9/V10 always increment gap_count). Lines 136-141 unconditionally add gaps for every segment to V9 and V10, making track_coverage always report 0% coverage for entity tracks. This is misleading in the segment map JSON and statistics output. The entity data is available in the pipeline state but not passed to _calculate_track_coverage. Need to thread entity_images/entity_videos through from the caller.

userStories.title: Add segment map schema versioning and metadata enrichment
acceptanceCriteria: generate_segment_map output JSON includes a 'schema_version' field set to '2.0'
Each segment entry includes 'matching_strategy' field extracted from match metadata (e.g., 'semantic', 'keyword', 'hybrid')
The output JSON includes a 'pipeline_info' section with stage versions and config hash
Backward-compatible: existing downstream tools ignore new fields gracefully
Add test verifying schema_version is present and segment entries contain matching_strategy field
userStories.notes: Tier: enhancement (low risk). Source files: src/otio/reporting.py:155-286 (generate_segment_map). Current output structure at line 265-275 has no version field. Add schema_version at top level. For matching_strategy, MatchResult objects (src/utils.py) may have strategy metadata — check match.primary_match for strategy info. If not available, default to 'unknown'. The pipeline_info section should include: pipeline_version (from __version__), config_hash (hash of output config), generation_timestamp.

userStories.title: Add comprehensive EDL confidence color mapping for all tiers
acceptanceCriteria: EDL color mapping covers all confidence levels returned by get_confidence_color(): GREEN, CYAN, YELLOW, ORANGE, RED, PINK, BLUE, PURPLE
Unknown/unmapped colors fall back to 'White' instead of being silently dropped
The color mapping is defined as a constant (EDL_COLOR_MAP) in export.py, not inline in the function
Add test generating EDL with all confidence levels (0.0 to 1.0 range), verify each maps to a valid EDL color
Add test for entity markers verifying PINK maps correctly
userStories.notes: Tier: enhancement (low risk). Source files: src/otio/export.py:352-360 (color_to_edl dict with 6 entries: GREEN->Mint, CYAN->Cyan, YELLOW->Yellow, ORANGE->Orange, RED->Red, PINK->Pink). get_confidence_color in src/otio/utils.py returns color strings based on confidence score thresholds. The current inline dict may not cover all colors returned by get_confidence_color (e.g., if BLUE or PURPLE are added). Extract to module-level constant, add fallback for unknown colors, and ensure DaVinci Resolve recognizes all mapped EDL color names.
